name: watch.window
description: Subscribe to window appear / disappear events. Emits EVENT frames as windows whose title matches the optional `title_prefix` come into existence or are destroyed.

title_prefix.description: Optional prefix filter (case-insensitive). When supplied, EVENT frames fire only for windows whose title starts with this prefix. Omit to receive all top-level window appear/disappear events.

x-event-schema.description: EVENT frames emitted on window create / destroy.

kind.description: `created` when a window appears; `destroyed` when it disappears.

title.description: Window title at the moment of the event. Empty string for windows without a title.

x-implementations.name: set_winevent_hook
x-implementations.description: Win32 `SetWinEventHook(EVENT_OBJECT_CREATE | EVENT_OBJECT_DESTROY, WINEVENT_OUTOFCONTEXT)`. NT 5+ — out-of-process hook with no DLL injection. Filtered to top-level windows + title_prefix in the agent's hook callback.

x-implementations.name: enum_windows_poll
x-implementations.description: Polling fallback for NT 4 / 9x where SetWinEventHook is unavailable. EnumWindows every 250 ms; diff against previous snapshot to compute appear/disappear.

windows-modern.description: SetWinEventHook with EVENT_OBJECT_CREATE / EVENT_OBJECT_DESTROY. Out-of-process, no DLL injection. Title prefix filtered in the agent's callback before emitting EVENTs.

windows-classic.description: SetWinEventHook on NT 5+; polling EnumWindows on NT 4 / 9x. The polling fallback may miss short-lived windows that appear and disappear within a single 250 ms interval.
